item.createvintageneoforged.convex_curvi: Can be installed to Curving Press to produce bucket-like recipes
item.createvintageneoforged.concave_curv: Can be installed to Curving Press to produce cone-like recipes
item.createvintageneoforged.w_shaped_cur: Can be installed to Curving Press to produce r-like recipes
item.createvintageneoforged.v_shaped_cur: Can be installed to Curving Press to produce L-like recipes
createvintageneoforged.ponder.belt_grind: Processing workpieces on the belt grinder
Belt grinders can process a wide variety of objects.
The workpiece to be processed always moves in the opposite direction to the rotation of the grinder.
createvintageneoforged.ponder.spring_coi: Processing Items on the Spring Coiling Machine
Spring Coiling Machines can process a variety of items
The processed item is always ejected out the front of the machine
createvintageneoforged.ponder.vacuum_cha: The Compressor has two operating modes that can be changed by right clicking it with a Wrench
Some recipes may require the heat of a Blaze Burner
Some recipes output fluids that appear inside Compressor block
To drain fluids you must use a Mechanical Pump
Some recipes require fluids inside the Compressor
You can fill the Compressor using a Mechanical Pump
createvintageneoforged.ponder.vibrating_: Processing Items on the Vibrating Table
The Vibrating Table can process a variety of items
Or vibrate leaves to get matched drops
It can be powered from the side using shafts
Throw or Insert items on the top
The outputs can be extracted via automation
createvintageneoforged.ponder.centrifuge: With a Centrifuge and a Basin, some Crafting Recipes can be automated
All of those recipes require the heat of a Blaze Burner
The filter slot can be used in case two recipes are conflicting.
createvintageneoforged.ponder.curving_pr: Processing Items with the Curving Press
Before work you must install any Curving Head to Curving Press
To remove head, you must right-click with a Wrench
The Curving Press can process items provided beneath it
The Input items can be dropped or placed on a Depot under the Press
When items are provided by a belt...
The Press will hold and process them automatically
createvintageneoforged.ponder.laser.head: Processing Items with the Laser
createvintageneoforged.ponder.laser.text: The Laser can process items provided beneath it
The Input items can be dropped or placed on a Depot under the Laser
When items are provided by a belt...
The Laser will hold and process them automatically
createvintageneoforged.ponder.helve_hamm: Processing Items with the Helve Hammer
The Helve Hammer has two operating modes
The mode depends on block under Hammer
The two blocks are: Anvil and Smithing Table
With a Smithing Table, the Helve Hammer will process any Smithing recipes
With an Anvil, the Helve Hammer will process special Hammering recipes
It can be powered from the side using shafts
Throw or Insert items on top of the Anvil or Smithing Table
After a set amount of hammer blows, the result can be obtained by right-clicking
Items can also be extracted/inserted by automation
createvintageneoforged.ponder.slots_bloc: Some recipes may require less then 3 ingredients
You can block redundant slots with Helve Hammer Slot Cover
You can remove Slot Covers via right-click with a Wrench
createvintageneoforged.ponder.lathe.head: Processing Items with the Lathe
createvintageneoforged.ponder.lathe.text: Lathe can process a variety of items
They must be powered from the side...
Ingredients can be inserted to front block via Right-click
To select a recipe, click on the back block
You need to do this every time
The result can be obtained via Right-click
The items can also be extracted/inserted by automation
createvintageneoforged.ponder.lathe_auto: Lathe can be automated with the Recipe Card
Use a Recipe Card via Right-click to define a recipe
Then you must put it inside a back Lathe block
Lathe will automatically apply chosen recipe
